Full summary: Fixed #31 server half: superseded_by back-links now written at supersede time in both backends, surfaced by twining_why, and backfilled for historical decisions by a new housekeeping pass. TDD, 1075 tests green, build/typecheck clean.
Decisions: [object Object]; [object Object]; [object Object]; [object Object]; [object Object]
Findings: Migration safety of new optional Decision fields is structural: export tree (stableStringify of full object), sqlite data blob, ingest, and reverse re-serialization all carry the whole Decision — any future optional field round-trips for free. Covered by a regression test in test/migrate/reverse.test.ts.; sqlite-backend.test.ts already exercised updateStatus with a superseded_by extra behind an `as never` cast — the field was anticipated but never typed or written by the engine; casts removed now that the type exists.; Fresh worktrees fail test/analytics until `node scripts/inject-posthog-key.mjs` (the prebuild step) generates src/analytics/_generated-posthog-key.ts — npm ci alone is not enough to run npm test.; One transient file-level test failure appeared in a single full-suite run (no individual test failed; two subsequent full runs 91/91 green) — likely an existing timing flake, not reproducible, not related to this change.
